an4.40:1.1: Atha kho Udāyi brāhmaṇo yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavatā . . . pe . . . Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Udāyi brāhmaṇo Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca :--
an4.40:1.2: Bhavam pi no Gotamo yaññaṃ vaṇṇetīti? 2.
an4.40:1.3: Na kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa sabbaṃ yaññaṃ vaṇṇemi
an4.40:1.4: na panāhaṃ brāhmaṇa sabbaṃ yaññaṃ na vaṇṇemi.
an4.40:1.5: Yathārūpe kho brāhmaṇa yaññe gāvo haññanti ajeḷakā haññanti kukkuṭasūkarā haññanti vividhā pāṇā saṅghātaṃ āpajjanti,
an4.40:1.6: evarūpaṃ kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa sārambhaṃ yaññaṃ na vaṇṇemi.
an4.40:1.8: Evarūpaṃ hi brāhmaṇa sārambhaṃ yaññaṃ na upasaṅkamanti arahanto vā arahamaggaṃ vā samāpannā.
an4.40:2.1: Yathārūpe ca kho brāhmaṇa yaññe n' eva gāvo haññanti na ajeḷakā haññanti na kukkuṭasūkarā haññanti na vividhā pāṇā saṅghātaṃ āpajjanti,
an4.40:2.2: evarūpaṃ kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa nirārambhaṃ yaññaṃ vaṇṇemi yadidaṃ niccadānaṃ anukulayaññaṃ.
an4.40:2.4: Evarūpaṃ hi brāhmana nirārambhaṃ yaññaṃ upasaṅkamanti arahanto vā arahamaggaṃ vā samapannā ti. 3.
